source_instruction: i am looking for a low sugar granola bar that is soy and diary free. pick the pack of 3 weighing 10 ounces.
query: Ugh, I just passed the community garden on my walk over and those sunflowers the retired elementary school teacher planted along the fence are finally fully bloomed—they’re taller than I am, heads so heavy with bright gold petals they’re drooping a little over the sidewalk, and a handful of fuzzy bumblebees were bumping around from flower to flower like they couldn’t decide which one had the best nectar. I even stopped for a second to say hi to her, and she pressed a crumpled paper bag full of the sweetest cherry tomatoes I’ve ever tasted into my hands, said her vines are producing way more than she and her cat can eat before they go bad. I popped one in my mouth right there and it was so warm from the sun it tasted like concentrated summer, I almost forgot I had a list of stuff to grab before I head back to the apartment. Hey, I’m browsing the non-dairy milks right now and need something that’s totally dairy free, no soy in it at all, and oh, make sure it’s got that little blue Fair Trade Certified stamp on the carton too—my roommate’s been raving about that lately. I want that one, the size we always grab when we’re restocking the fridge for our morning smoothies, y’know? Don’t grab anything that costs too much, I can’t go over forty bucks total for whatever I end up picking up today. Wait, hold on, actually don’t worry about the sweetener level, I don’t care about that part right now, just make sure it fits the other stuff I mentioned.

extras.text: make sure it’s got that little blue Fair Trade Certified stamp on the carton too
